sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾遭到斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了千方百计来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查到了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份，却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: In 1978, nine-year-old Tammy Moore had an exceptionally close relationship with her mother, Marie Moore.
sentences.zh: 1978年，9岁的塔米·穆尔（Tammy Moore）与母亲玛丽·穆尔（Marie Moore）的关系极其亲密。

sentences.en: Marie adored Tammy, and she loved being a mum.
sentences.zh: 玛丽疼爱塔米，也非常享受做母亲的感觉。

sentences.en: She had told Tammy that she never felt loved by her own parents.
sentences.zh: 她曾对塔米说，她从未从自己的父母那里感受到爱。

sentences.en: Even though Marie was an only child, she'd always felt starved of attention and affection.
sentences.zh: 尽管玛丽是独生女，但她总是觉得自己极度缺乏关注和关爱。

sentences.en: She told Tammy that her mother and father had always told her she was ugly and wouldn't amount to anything.
sentences.zh: 她告诉塔米，她的父母总是说她长得丑，而且一无是处。

sentences.en: This upbringing resulted in Marie looking for love wherever she could find it, and constantly moving to new locations as though she was searching for something.
sentences.zh: 这种成长经历导致玛丽四处寻找爱，并不断搬家，仿佛在寻找着什么东西。

sentences.en: When she unexpectedly became pregnant in her early 20s, Marie initially considered having an abortion.
sentences.zh: 当她在20出头时意外怀孕时，玛丽最初曾考虑过堕胎。

sentences.en: But, realising that a baby could be exactly what she'd been searching for,
sentences.zh: 但她意识到，一个孩子可能正是她一直在寻找的东西，

sentences.en: Marie decided to go through with the pregnancy and raise her daughter as a single parent.
sentences.zh: 于是玛丽决定把孩子生下来，并作为单亲母亲抚养女儿。

sentences.en: She was a doting and indulgent mother.
sentences.zh: 她是一位溺爱且纵容孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: Tammy could misbehave and be rude at times, later describing herself as a rotten child.
sentences.zh: 塔米有时会调皮捣蛋、很不礼貌，她后来形容自己是个讨人嫌的小孩。

sentences.en: But Marie never disciplined or reprimanded her.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽从未管教或斥责过她。

sentences.en: Tammy didn't feel as though she was missing anything by not knowing her father.
sentences.zh: 塔米并不觉得自己不知道父亲是谁是一种缺失。

sentences.en: There were lots of other single parent families in their neighbourhood, and it wasn't unusual for the kids that she knew to not have a dad around.
sentences.zh: 她们的街区里有很多其他的单亲家庭，她认识的孩子没有父亲在身边也是常有的事。

sentences.en: But she did wonder sometimes who her father was.
sentences.zh: 但她有时确实很好奇自己的父亲究竟是谁。

sentences.en: One evening, Tammy and Marie were watching television.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，塔米和玛丽正在看电视。

sentences.en: Out of nowhere, Tammy turned around to face her mother and asked,
sentences.zh: 毫无征兆地，塔米转过身面向母亲问：

sentences.en: Who's my dad?
sentences.zh: “我爸爸是谁？”

sentences.en: Marie pointed at the TV set and said,
sentences.zh: 玛丽指着电视机说：

sentences.en: He's your dad.
sentences.zh: “他就是你爸爸。”

sentences.en: She was pointing at American singer-songwriter Billy Joel, who was currently on the show they had been watching.
sentences.zh: 她指的是当时正在她们看的节目中出现的美国创作型歌手比利·乔尔（Billy Joel）。

sentences.en: In 1978, Billy Joel was one of the biggest names in pop music, having released an album the previous year titled The Stranger that went certified platinum.
sentences.zh: 1978年，比利·乔尔是流行乐坛最大牌的明星之一，他前一年发行的专辑《局外人》（The Stranger）获得了白金唱片认证。

sentences.en: Marie told Tammy that when she was younger, she'd had an affair with Billy Joel, which had resulted in Tammy's conception.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉塔米，她年轻时曾与比利·乔尔有过一段情，塔米就是那时怀上的。

sentences.en: That's why you can sing, she said.
sentences.zh: “难怪你会唱歌，”她说。

sentences.en: Tammy was thrilled by this news, but Marie cautioned her that she wasn't to tell anybody.
sentences.zh: 塔米听到这个消息兴奋不已，但玛丽告诫她千万不要告诉任何人。

sentences.en: If people knew, they would treat her differently.
sentences.zh: 如果别人知道了，就会用异样的眼光看待她。

sentences.en: It had to be kept a secret.
sentences.zh: 这件事必须保密。

sentences.en: By 1981, Marie and Tammy were living in an apartment
sentences.zh: 到1981年时，玛丽和塔米住在一个公寓里，

sentences.en: in a narrow, three-storey weatherboard house in the city of Patterson, New Jersey, the state where Marie had been born and raised.
sentences.zh: 位于新泽西州帕特森市（Patterson）一栋狭窄的三层木板房内，这也是玛丽出生和成长的地方。

sentences.en: Their household had also grown.
sentences.zh: 她们的家庭成员也变多了。

sentences.en: Marie's friend, 50-year-old Mary Gardulo, had moved in with them.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的朋友、50岁的玛丽·加杜洛（Mary Gardulo）搬来和她们一起住。

sentences.en: Although she was 15 years older than Marie, the two women were close.
sentences.zh: 尽管她比玛丽大15岁，但两人关系非常要好。

sentences.en: Marie had also taken custody of 12-year-old Harriet Bain, who was the daughter of a friend.
sentences.zh: 玛丽还收养了朋友的女儿、12岁的哈丽特·贝恩（Harriet Bain）。

sentences.en: Harriet's family had been going through a difficult time, so Marie had offered to take her in.
sentences.zh: 哈丽特的家庭当时正经历一段艰难时期，于是玛丽主动提出收留她。

sentences.en: It helped that Harriet was the same age as Tammy and the two got along well.
sentences.zh: 哈丽特和塔米同龄，两人相处得很融洽，这帮了很大的忙。

sentences.en: The Moore home was often bustling with other visitors who didn't live there as well.
sentences.zh: 穆尔的家里也经常挤满了并不住在那里、来来往往的访客。

sentences.en: During the summer of 1981, it became a popular place for neighbourhood kids to hang out.
sentences.zh: 1981年夏天，这里成了附近孩子们聚会的热门场所。

sentences.en: 35-year-old Marie Moore was always happy to play host and was seen as a fun and cool mother.
sentences.zh: 35岁的玛丽·穆尔总是乐于当东道主，被大家视为一个有趣且酷炫的母亲。

sentences.en: She took her daughter Tammy and her friends on outings to the beach, bowling alleys and amusement parks.
sentences.zh: 她带着女儿塔米和她的朋友们去海滩、保龄球馆和游乐园郊游。

sentences.en: On other occasions, they'd just stay at home, singing songs at the top of their lungs around the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 有时，他们就待在家里的餐桌旁，声嘶力竭地唱着歌。

sentences.en: It was a fun and raucous environment for the pre-teens to escape to.
sentences.zh: 对于这些即将进入青春期的孩子来说，这是一个充满乐趣且喧闹的避风港。

sentences.en: Everybody was welcome and they could stay as long as they wanted.
sentences.zh: 每个人都受到欢迎，而且想待多久就待多久。

sentences.en: Three children who regularly spent time at the Moors were Marie's goddaughter, 12-year-old Teresa Fury,
sentences.zh: 有三个经常在穆尔家度过时间的年轻人是：玛丽的教女、12岁的特蕾莎·弗瑞（Teresa Fury），

sentences.en: 13-year-old Luis Montalvo and 14-year-old Ricky Flores.
sentences.zh: 13岁的路易斯·蒙塔尔沃（Luis Montalvo）和14岁的里奇·弗洛雷斯（Ricky Flores）。

sentences.en: Tammy Moore thought Ricky was handsome and she soon started dating the boy who was two years her senior.
sentences.zh: 塔米·穆尔觉得里奇长得很帅，不久便开始和这个比她大两岁的男孩交往。

sentences.en: It was very much a youthful romance and wasn't serious.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是一场青涩的恋爱，并不严肃。

sentences.en: Over the course of the summer, the children's attachment to Tammy's mother, Marie, led to Harriet, Teresa, Luis and Ricky all calling her Ma as well.
sentences.zh: 整个夏天，孩子们对塔米母亲玛丽的依恋，导致哈丽特、特蕾莎、路易斯和里奇也都开始叫她“妈（Ma）”。

sentences.en: Together, they formed a tight-knit unit that spent every day together.
sentences.zh: 他们聚在一起，形成了一个每天形影不离的紧密群体。

sentences.en: On Sunday, September 13, 1981, once all of the children were back at school,
sentences.zh: 1981年9月13日，星期日，孩子们都开学返校后，

sentences.en: Marie Moore decided to let them in on her and Tammy's secret.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·穆尔决定把她和塔米的秘密告诉他们。

sentences.en: She told the four other children that Tammy's real father was the pop star, Billy Joel.
sentences.zh: 她告诉其他四个孩子，塔米的亲生父亲是流行巨星比利·乔尔。

sentences.en: Marie explained that she and Billy had been married some years earlier.
sentences.zh: 玛丽解释说，她和比利几年前曾结过婚。

sentences.en: Marie's friend, Mary Gardullo, who also lived in the apartment, was already aware of this connection.
sentences.zh: 同样住在公寓里的玛丽的朋友玛丽·加杜洛对此事早已知情。

sentences.en: Marie had told her several years ago of her involvement with the famous singer-songwriter.
sentences.zh: 玛丽几年前就告诉过她自己与这位著名创作型歌手有过一段情。

sentences.en: To everyone else, this news came as a surprise.
sentences.zh: 对其他人来说，这个消息是个突如其来的惊喜。

sentences.en: But that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此。

sentences.en: Marie told them that Billy Joel had decided to become more involved in their lives to help restore some order to the Moore residents.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉他们，比利·乔尔决定更多地介入他们的生活，以帮助恢复穆尔家的秩序。

sentences.en: The household had become too chaotic during the summer and Billy wanted this to be corrected.
sentences.zh: 这个家在夏天变得太混乱了，比利希望纠正这种状况。

sentences.en: The children were confused by this sudden announcement.
sentences.zh: 孩子们对这突如其来的宣布感到困惑。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, the home's telephone rang in the living room.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，客厅里的电话响了。

sentences.en: Marie went to answer it.
sentences.zh: 玛丽去接了电话。

sentences.en: She called out that it was Billy on the phone.
sentences.zh: 她大喊着说是比利打来的。

sentences.en: Harriet, Teresa, Luis and Ricky were to join her in the living room.
sentences.zh: 哈丽特、特蕾莎、路易斯和里奇被要求去客厅找她。

sentences.en: But Tammy and Marie's 50-year-old housemate,
sentences.zh: 但塔米和玛丽50岁的室友

sentences.en: Mary, were not.
sentences.zh: 玛丽则不用去。

sentences.en: Everyone did as they were asked, with Tammy and Mary staying away while the other four children gathered around
sentences.zh: 所有人都照做了，塔米和玛丽留在远处，而另外四个孩子则聚集在客厅的

sentences.en: Marie in the living room.
sentences.zh: 玛丽身边。

sentences.en: They listened as Marie began relaying instructions from Billy on the other line.
sentences.zh: 他们听着玛丽开始传达电话那头比利下达的指示。

sentences.en: She explained that they were each to start performing whatever household chores Billy asked of them.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，他们每个人都要开始完成比利要求的各种家务。

sentences.en: Every day before school, they were to go to the Moore residents to complete their chores, which would change on a weekly basis.
sentences.zh: 每天上学前，他们都要去穆尔家完成家务，家务内容每周都会更换。

sentences.en: Marie said that Billy had also demanded that Ricky Flores become engaged to Tammy, despite the pair's young ages and the fact that they were not in a serious relationship.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说，比利还要求里奇·弗洛雷斯与塔米订婚，尽管两人年纪尚小，而且并非在认真恋爱。

sentences.en: Ricky was to be in charge of the household alongside Marie to see if he would make a suitable husband for Tammy.
sentences.zh: 里奇将与玛丽一起负责管理这个家，看看他是否能成为一个合适的塔米丈夫。

sentences.en: Marie added that in addition to being a pop star,
sentences.zh: 玛丽补充说，除了是一位流行巨星外，

sentences.en: Billy Joel was in the mafia.
sentences.zh: 比利·乔尔还是黑手党成员。

sentences.en: He had organised crime connections who would harm their children's families if they disobeyed him.
sentences.zh: 他有着有组织犯罪的人脉，如果他们敢违抗他，他就会伤害他们孩子的家人。

sentences.en: If they did not do as told or if they told anybody outside of the home what was going on, then Billy would arrange for a bomb to detonate at the residence.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不按吩咐办事，或者把发生的事情告诉屋外的人，比利就会安排在住所引爆一颗炸弹。

sentences.en: The children were shocked and scared.
sentences.zh: 孩子们感到震惊又害怕。

sentences.en: They liked and trusted Marie and had no reason to believe she would lie to them.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢并信任玛丽，没有任何理由相信她会对自己撒谎。

sentences.en: Plus, they had all heard the phone ring in the other room while she was busy talking to them.
sentences.zh: 况且，当她在另一间屋子里忙着和对方通话时，他们都亲耳听到了电话铃响。

sentences.en: That seemed to prove that Billy Joel really was contacting her.
sentences.zh: 这似乎证明了比利·乔尔确实在联系她。

sentences.en: Mary Gardullo had become distraught and afraid upon hearing about the phone call and was clearly already aware of Billy's role in Marie's life and the danger he imposed.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·加杜洛在听到这通电话后变得心烦意乱、惊恐不安，显然她已经清楚比利在玛丽生活中的角色以及他带来的危险。

sentences.en: Her reaction appeared to be confirmation of Marie's claiMs.
sentences.zh: 她的反应似乎证实了玛丽的说法。

sentences.en: So, the children did as they were told.
sentences.zh: 于是，孩子们照着吩咐做了。

sentences.en: Every day after school and sometimes before as well, they made their way to the Moors' apartment ready to do whatever Billy needed them to.
sentences.zh: 每天放学后，有时甚至在上学前，他们都会赶往穆尔的公寓，随时准备做比利需要他们做的任何事。

sentences.en: Marie would be waiting with a list of rules and tasks that Billy had provided over the phone.
sentences.zh: 玛丽会拿着一张比利通过电话提供的规章制度和任务清单在等候。

sentences.en: The children set about completing their chores.
sentences.zh: 孩子们开始着手完成家务。

sentences.en: These included cleaning the bathroom, dusting surfaces, and washing the dishes.
sentences.zh: 这些包括打扫浴室、擦拭表面灰尘以及洗碗。

sentences.en: Marie told Ricky that as head of the household, he had to inspect everything after they finished.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉里奇，作为一家之主，他必须在大家干完活后检查所有东西。

sentences.en: If the chores hadn't been completed to Billy's satisfaction or performed quickly enough, then Ricky would have to discipline the other children.
sentences.zh: 如果家务没能让比利满意，或者完成得不够快，里奇就必须惩罚其他孩子。

sentences.en: On one occasion,
sentences.zh: 有一次，

sentences.en: Ricky looked everything over and told Marie that the chores had been done.
sentences.zh: 里奇检查了一遍所有事情，告诉玛丽家务已经做完了。

sentences.en: Marie replied that Billy didn't agree.
sentences.zh: 玛丽回答说比利不同意。

sentences.en: He had hidden cameras set up around the apartment so that he could survey the goings-on remotely and he'd told Marie that the children hadn't cleaned
sentences.zh: 他在公寓周围安装了隐藏摄像头，以便远程监视这里发生的事情，而且他告诉玛丽，孩子们没有把

sentences.en: under the kitchen table properly.
sentences.zh: 餐桌底下彻底打扫干净。

sentences.en: At this,
sentences.zh: 听到这话，

sentences.en: Ricky went to check the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 里奇去检查了餐桌。

sentences.en: There was dirt beneath it, just as Billy had said.
sentences.zh: 桌子底下正如比利所说有灰尘。

sentences.en: This appeared to be proof that Billy was watching their every move.
sentences.zh: 这似乎证明了比利正在监视他们的一举一动。

sentences.en: He went back to Marie and told her that Billy was right.
sentences.zh: 他回到玛丽身边，告诉她比利是对的。

sentences.en: Marie told Ricky that as punishment for not doing their chores properly,
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉里奇，作为没有好好做家务的惩罚，

sentences.en: Billy wanted Ricky to beat the other kids with a wiffle ball bat, a long, hollow plastic bat used to play a variation on baseball.
sentences.zh: 比利希望里奇用威浮球棒（wiffle ball bat）殴打其他孩子，这是一种用来玩棒球变体游戏的、长而中空的塑料球棒。

sentences.en: Ricky did so as Marie remained on the phone, relaying further directions from Billy.
sentences.zh: 里奇照做了，而玛丽则留在电话旁，传达比利进一步的指令。

sentences.en: A familiar routine quickly began.
sentences.zh: 一种熟悉的日常很快开始了。

sentences.en: Each day after the children arrived at the apartment, the phone would ring and Billy would be on the other line.
sentences.zh: 每天孩子们到达公寓后，电话就会响起，电话那头就是比利。

sentences.en: While Marie held the receiver and spoke to Billy, she would ask the children to recite the rules they'd been given.
sentences.zh: 当玛丽拿着听筒和比利说话时，她会要求孩子们背诵给他们的规章制度。

sentences.en: If anyone made a mistake or forgot a rule, then Marie ordered Ricky to discipline them until they could recite the rules correctly.
sentences.zh: 如果有人出错或忘记了一条规则，玛丽就会命令里奇惩罚他们，直到他们能正确背出规则为止。

sentences.en: After any punishments had been doled out, the kids would complete their chores, with further beatings if they were deemed to have done a poor job.
sentences.zh: 惩罚实施完毕后，孩子们就要完成家务，如果被认为活没干好，还会面临进一步的殴打。

sentences.en: The punishments grew worse over time.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，惩罚变得越来越严重。

sentences.en: Marie's daughter,
sentences.zh: 玛丽的女儿

sentences.en: Tammy, was exempt from the chores everyone else had to perform.
sentences.zh: 塔米免于承担其他人必须去做的家务。

sentences.en: Because her mother didn't want her around when Billy called,
sentences.zh: 因为她母亲不想让她在比利打电话时在场，

sentences.en: Tammy would excuse herself when the phone rang and usually went outside to play.
sentences.zh: 所以每当电话铃响时塔米就会退下，通常会去外面玩。

sentences.en: But she later recalled that on one occasion,
sentences.zh: 但她后来回忆说，有一次，

sentences.en: Ricky had entered her bedroom without asking and used a set of thumb cuffs to cuff her thumbs together, effectively binding her hands.
sentences.zh: 里奇未经允许闯入她的卧室，用一副拇指手铐把她的两只拇指铐在一起，实际上是绑住了她的双手。

sentences.en: He then left, closing and locking the door behind him.
sentences.zh: 然后他离开并顺手关上并反锁了门。

sentences.en: Tammy tried desperately to wiggle out of the thumb cuffs to no avail, and the whole time she could hear the other children crying and begging in another part of the apartment.
sentences.zh: 塔米拼命挣扎想从拇指手铐里脱身，却无济于事，而在这期间她一直能听到其他孩子在公寓的另一头哭泣和哀求。
